questions.question: Overfitting là gì và cách phát hiện/fix?

options.A: Model fit training data too well → low train error, high val error. Fix: regularization, dropout, more data, early stopping

questions.explanation: Overfitting: memorize training data. Detect: train loss ↓ nhưng val loss ↑. Fix: L1/L2 regularization, Dropout (neural nets), Pruning (trees), more training data, data augmentation, ensemble.

questions.question: Precision vs Recall trade-off — khi nào ưu tiên Recall cao hơn Precision?

options.A: Khi false negative tốn kém (cancer detection: bỏ sót bệnh nhân). High Recall: ít false negatives dù nhiều false positives
options.D: F1 score giải quyết tất cả

questions.explanation: Precision = TP/(TP+FP): trong những gì predict positive, bao nhiêu thực sự positive. Recall = TP/(TP+FN): trong những gì thực sự positive, bao nhiêu bị detect. Cancer: high Recall (bỏ sót nguy hiểm). Spam filter: high Precision (inbox quan trọng).

questions.question: Vanishing gradient problem trong deep networks là gì?

options.A: Gradients become exponentially small → early layers learn slowly. Fix: ResNet skip connections, BatchNorm, better activations (ReLU/GELU)

questions.explanation: Chain rule trong backprop: gradient = product of many Jacobians. Sigmoid/tanh: saturate → gradients near 0 → vanish. ReLU không saturate (positive side). ResNet: skip connections → gradient highway. BatchNorm: normalize activations → stable gradients.

questions.question: Transfer Learning: khi nào freeze layers vs fine-tune toàn bộ?

options.A: Small dataset giống domain: freeze all, train classifier. Large dataset: fine-tune all. Similar domain: freeze early, tune late layers

questions.explanation: Pretrained model: early layers = general features (edges, textures), late layers = task-specific. Small similar dataset: freeze all, train head. Small different: unfreeze more. Large dataset: fine-tune with low LR. Catastrophic forgetting: learning too fast erases pretrained knowledge.
